fact: The Ministry of Justice states that Proclamation No. 1321/2024 is approved and in force, that personal data may go to a third-party jurisdiction only where it ensures appropriate protection, and that sensitive personal data needs the Authority's prior approval to leave the country (art. 22(3)).
title: የግል ዳታ ጥበቃ በኢትዮጵያ ሕግ • Personal Data Protection in Ethiopian Law
